A NOTE, JUST FOR YOU

Hey Gi,

I know I’ve been a little quiet. Exams took up a lot of my time, and I haven’t put in the effort I wanted to. But I didn’t forget you, or the promise.

So here’s your own little corner of the internet. A little pink, a little extra, and a very unsubtle way of saying I’d like to get to know you better.

I liked our first date.
I’d really like a second.

And yes, I remember the Off-Campus promise, too.

With a little courage,
your slightly nerdy date ♡
